log: pick-start-tile spliced candidates out of the list it was iterating, so the candidate after each removed one was never checked (and the cached list was narrowed as a side effect). It now filters a copy and leaves the cache alone (civ-clone/web-renderer#191).

As in v474.05, a civilization only starts on a landmass with at least 32 Grassland, Plains or River tiles. When no free candidate has that much room, it falls back to the landmass with the most (civ-clone/web-renderer#232).

The spacing filter used Tile#distanceFrom, the engine's straight-line measure, so a tile 4 across and 1 down (straight-line 4.12) passed while Civ1 counts it as 4. It now uses civ1Distance, like the package's other Civ1 rules, and the test asserts the same measure.
